Data-freshness note:
Date range to Category Location SKU type
Date range, category, location, and SKU-type filters apply across Tab 1, Tab 2, and Tab 3 (and the topline below). The topline's "Total Orders" denominator also narrows by Location (so WFR% for a single warehouse is meaningful), but not by Category or SKU type — those don't partition all orders placed, only the numerator. Tab 3's "Total orders processed" denominator stays pinned to the full 90-day window since a picker/checker's total throughput needs the full window to be meaningful, but "Error orders" (and the derived error-free count / error rate) recompute live from the filtered tickets, and the Location filter narrows which warehouse groups are shown. "T-2" (day before yesterday) replaces the old "Yesterday" quick-filter and Tab 4's pull window, per ops feedback that Warehouse-team comments often aren't posted yet by the time T-1 data is pulled. Tab 4 is always T-2, unaffected by these filters. SKU-type classification (cold-chain vs non-cold) is only available for orders placed in the last 90 days; a handful of very old or edge-case orders with no item-batch record show as "Unknown" and are excluded when a SKU-type filter is active.

Macro trend — delivered orders vs. issues raised vs. accepted

Whole-network view, not affected by any filter on this page (date range, category, location) — delivered orders (not created), total issues raised, and WH Accepted broken into the 5 categories that sum to it. The frozen columns on the left are aggregate totals; the day-by-day columns scroll sideways, most recent complete day first. Shows complete days up to T-2 only — the Warehouse team needs ~2 days to investigate and comment, so WH Accepted for anything newer would be understated. The tiles, charts and ticket list on this tab are not capped, so their totals can be higher than this table's by the held-back tickets.

Weekly Leaderboard
Active warehouses only, for the active week. Eligibility (green + chip) requires BOTH metrics green: Errors/1000 Orders < 0.2 (WH-Accepted mis-shipments, deduped per order, refreshed daily) AND RFD < 0.5% (Warehouse-attributable RFD/manifest breach rate, computed once per week from ClickHouse). One metric red = yellow row; both red = red row. DocPharma is a partner site, listed separately below and out of scope for the reward.

No decision - where the return request stands
Return request not raised = no return row exists in ClickHouse for the order; cancelled = every return request on the order is cancelled (cancelledReturn / returnPickupCancelled); raised = in progress or completed. Split by the no-decision reason.

WFR funnel - wrong medicine, missing / short qty, expiry, MRP / batch
Each cell is count | % of its parent row. A complaint is one order x complaint type. The baseline is the union of ClickHouse return requests (final reason per item - a customer's first, abandoned pick is ignored) and Zoho Desk tickets (every disposition). "No investigation ticket" = the customer complained but nobody opened a ticket. Cancelled / rejected-at-QC returns are excluded from the funnel. Warehouse input: raised in the last 2 days = "Not due yet (T-2)". Damage and order swap are on their own tabs.
Click any number in the table to list the complaints behind it (same filter, same count) - order, ticket, what the customer said, what the warehouse said.

Order damage - complaints, tickets and what the photos show
Each cell is count | % of its parent row. A complaint is one order x complaint type. The baseline is the union of ClickHouse return requests (final reason per item - a customer's first, abandoned pick is ignored) and Zoho Desk tickets (every disposition). "No investigation ticket" = the customer complained but nobody opened a ticket. Cancelled / rejected-at-QC returns are excluded from the funnel. Warehouse input: raised in the last 2 days = "Not due yet (T-2)". Physical damage is split by what the customer photo shows (hand-read); temperature complaints (cold chain) are not photo-read.
